data.description:
## Story

As a local `/dso:commit` user, the review workflow loops cycles internally within one invocation, dispatches the cycle-end arbiter when max_cycles is reached or STABLE_HALT fires, and writes arbiter rulings to a sidecar that the pre-commit gate reads alongside reviewer-findings.json, so that local commits get the same convergence guarantee as CI PRs without the user having to push to a PR first, and the commit gate enforces arbiter BLOCK rulings.

## Done Definitions

- [ ] New orchestrator: `plugins/dso/scripts/review-workflow.sh` (or Python equivalent) that wraps the existing review-gate dispatch. Called by /dso:commit BEFORE the pre-commit hook fires. Handles the multi-cycle loop.
- [ ] Local cycle ledger at $ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json, per-branch scope. On invocation: read ledger; if HEAD commit_sha differs from last cycle's commit_sha → reset cycle counter (start cycle 1); if same SHA → continue from cycle_num+1 (idempotent re-run protection, matches Story 10's cycle_dispatcher SHORT_CIRCUIT logic).
- [ ] Multi-cycle loop: while cycle_dispatcher.next_action returns DISPATCH_NEXT, dispatch reviewer agents, run resolution loop, write reviewer-findings.json, append to ledger, increment cycle_num. Break loop on PASS, DISPATCH_ARBITER, or SHORT_CIRCUIT.
- [ ] On DISPATCH_ARBITER: bundle arbiter input (unresolved findings + all prior cycle defenses from defense store + diff + cycle ledger excerpt for cross_cycle_pattern + per-reviewer-agent breakdown for cross_reviewer_agreement). Call dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter. Pass output to arbiter_processor.process_rulings(rulings, finding_map, cycle_num, commit_sha, pr_number=None, branch_name=<current branch>).
- [ ] arbiter-rulings.json sidecar written to $ARTIFACTS_DIR atomically. Contains BLOCK list, ruling per finding, schema_version=1.0.0.
- [ ] Local DEFER processing: orphan ticket created with dedup key = finding_hash + branch_name (NOT PR_NUMBER, which is absent). Tags: orphan:deferred_review + origin:arbiter; priority 3.
- [ ] Local DROP processing: defense_store_write to tracker only (PR store skipped because PR_NUMBER is absent). defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter.
- [ ] Pre-commit hook (review-gate.sh or whichever currently reads reviewer-findings.json) extended: ALSO read arbiter-rulings.json from $ARTIFACTS_DIR. If file present AND has any ruling with ruling='BLOCK' for the current HEAD commit_sha → block commit with error message including BLOCK rationales. If absent or no BLOCK → allow commit.
- [ ] E2E shell test: simulate /dso:commit scenario with 3 cycles + STABLE_HALT + arbiter dispatch + BLOCK in result → assert pre-commit gate blocks with arbiter rationale shown.

## Considerations

- [Pre-commit gate separation] The user clarified: arbiter fires when the review is written (inside review-workflow.sh), NOT when the pre-commit hook fires. The hook only reads the final status. This decoupling lets us run multi-cycle review without blocking each cycle on a hook invocation.
- [Local cycle scope] Per-branch + commit_sha-aware. Switching branches starts a fresh ledger context; ledger file is shared but cycle_dispatcher's SHA logic isolates branch sessions.
- [Defense store local-only DROP] Document the asymmetry: locally DROP defenses go only to the tracker; CI also writes to PR store. process_rulings handles the PR_NUMBER-conditional logic.
- [Performance] A local multi-cycle review can take several minutes (each cycle = one LLM dispatch). User sees progress output. Long invocations are expected; this is the cost of convergence guarantee.
- [Interrupt handling] If user Ctrl-Cs mid-cycle, partial ledger may be written. Atomic writes prevent corruption; restart will detect partial state via SHA check.
- [Ordering] Depends on Stories 10, 11, 12.
- [Escalation policy] Escalate when blocked.
data.title: As a local /dso:commit user, the review workflow loops cycles internally and dispatches the arbiter at halt conditions; pre-commit gate reads the final reviewer + arbiter status
